details.title: Diminished scales, half-whole
details.lead: Half step, whole step, all the way up: the scale of a 7♭9 chord. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
